purpose: Teach: 公庫/汎用/中級/勘案/解禁/焼却/税法/公述

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、政策金融公庫絡みの詐欺に注意しております
lines.en: We're keeping a careful watch on fraud cases involving government policy finance institutions.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Steady pace. Each phrase lands with equal weight—no rushing. Slight formality in posture. The voice of someone delivering important information clearly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。汎用システムへの不正アクセスを警察、検知されたんですね
lines.en: I see. So the police detected unauthorized access to the general system.
lines.style: Attentive, respectful. Slight lean-in. Warm but not casual. Acknowledging what's being said without performing surprise. The tone of someone genuinely following along.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、中級捜査員の研修を実施しております
lines.en: We're currently running training programs for mid-level investigators.
lines.style: Professional, matter-of-fact. Slight upward inflection on 「研修」—emphasizing the proactive step. Even-handed delivery. The voice of procedure and preparation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、ご意見を勘案した方針、ありがたいです
lines.en: Thank you. I'm grateful the police are taking those perspectives into account when setting policy.
lines.style: Sincere gratitude underneath. Warm but measured. Not effusive—genuine appreciation delivered with quiet respect. A small nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、押収品の解禁時期を慎重に決めております
lines.en: We're being deliberate about when we release seized materials.
lines.style: Calm, deliberate. Slightly slower pace on 「慎重に」—emphasizing the care being taken. Composed and thorough. The voice of someone who understands the stakes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証拠保管庫の焼却防止、警察、強化されているそうですね
lines.en: Yes. I understand you've strengthened measures to prevent evidence storage from being destroyed.
lines.style: Acknowledging and affirming. Steady, conversational. A slight warmth—showing he's been listening carefully. Not mechanical, but respectful of the official context.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、税法違反の捜査も担当しております
lines.en: We're also handling investigations into tax law violations.
lines.style: Even, factual delivery. No particular emphasis—this is simply part of the scope. Clear and authoritative without harshness. The voice of someone stating what falls under their jurisdiction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害者の公述を警察、適切に支援されますね
lines.en: And I'm sure you're supporting victims appropriately when they come forward with statements.
lines.style: Warm, thoughtful. A slight rise in sincerity—this question matters to him beyond the formal exchange. Calm but engaged. The voice of someone checking that human care is part of the process.
